objective: A frozen census of 113 doubling schedules on the 13 x 13, 21 x 21 and 41 x 41 tubes at g = 3 and the 13 x 13 tube at g = 2 and 5: for four readings (route ring to ring and cell to cell, plain hearing ring to ring and cell to cell), the conformal gap between the diagonal and the axis original ring at the same taxicab distance, and its slope over the distance; rounder than taxicab if the slope is at most -g/2.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-10 (exploratory, exact; frozen contract; Q1 to Q3 hold): on 113 doubling schedules to distance 20, route readings stay taxicab (diagonal-minus-axis gaps within -9 and 0, slopes near 0), and growth never rounds the plain reading: every plain slope is on the square side; on the fixed first stage the diagonal ring at taxicab d is heard plainly 4g (2^ceil(log2 d) - d) lags after the axis ring (24 of 24 baseline gaps).
title: Does growth round the reading
